_comment: PROTOTYPE — throwaway. Sketch C: the same workflow authored in-app and persisted in T3 state. The `definition` is byte-for-byte the A1 document; everything around it is what storage forces T3 to invent. See NOTES.md.
name: plan-implement-test-review

plan.prompt:
You are the Plan node of an automated T3 workflow.

## Task

{{ inputs.task }}

## Instructions

Write a short, concrete implementation plan. Do not modify any files.

You are the Implement node of an automated T3 workflow.

## Plan

{{ nodes.plan.latest.output }}

## Instructions

Apply the plan in this worktree, then summarise what you changed.

fix.prompt:
You are the Fix node of an automated T3 workflow (attempt {{ run.attempt }}).

## Review feedback

{{ nodes.review.latest.output }}

## Latest test run

{{ nodes.test.latest.output }}

## Instructions

Address every point in the review feedback and the failing test output.

_promptsAreWorseHere: Escaped into JSON strings, every prompt is now a single unreadable line. The YAML sketch is the same document and is readable; this one is not editable by hand at all, which is the point — a stored definition presumes an editor.

_runsPinAVersion._why: Without this, editing a workflow mid-run changes the workflow under the run. Git gives the in-repo forms this for free — a run pins a commit.
